> **Independent implementation:** CellCharterR is an independent R
> implementation of methods described by the CellCharter project. It is not
> affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by the original CellCharter
> authors or the Computational Systems Oncology group. Questions and bug
> reports concerning CellCharterR should be directed to the
> [CellCharterR issue tracker](https://github.com/cperalta-viteri/CellCharterR/issues),
> not to the upstream CellCharter project.

The complete mouse-spleen analysis is the primary CellCharterR reproducibility
report. It contains the full visible code, pinned versions, checkpoints,
AutoK-selected K=4 result, separately labelled K=11 sensitivity analysis,
cell-type enrichment, neighborhood enrichment, and differential neighborhood
enrichment.

The report is intentionally precomputed. Package build, check, and CI must not
read or recompute the 707,474-cell analysis. The preserved HTML is shipped with
the package and can be opened immediately:

[Open the complete mouse-spleen reproducibility report](../reports/CellCharterR-mouse-spleen-reproducibility.html)

The report and corresponding visible source are installed under the package's
`reports/` directory. Its full-scale inputs and checkpointed outputs are
distributed separately from the software package.

## Citing CellCharterR

Christian Peralta Viteri is the author and maintainer of CellCharterR. Retrieve
the package's current, version-aware citation and copyable BibTeX with:

```{r package-citation}
citation("CellCharterR")
```
